subject: hurricane

identity.evidence: The original horizontal tangled ribbon bundle remains recognizable across all keys: long upper loop, pointed rightward convergence, central crossing strokes and lower zigzag tail. Deformation retains its rough original line vocabulary; the held building also relates directly to the source.

poses.evidence: The source is stormwater/surf striking a building, with the pronounced near-building splash concentrated in the early selected keys. The drawing reaches its largest raised left-hand crest in key three, after the comparable source splash has substantially subsided. Later flatter keys are plausible, but this main phase ordering is not supported by the source.

biggest_gap: The most prominent crest is assigned to key three instead of the early source impact phase.
smallest_repair: Move the existing pronounced raised-left crest to key one or two and settle key three toward the flatter bundle already used later. Preserve the same stroke bundle, rightward point, and held building; do not add a cyclone.
protect: Building-and-surf interpretation of the selected source
scope: Only design.png, first six board-v1 tiles and held-background tile seven, selected 16-frame and six-key source contact sheets were inspected. No rendered motion was reviewed.
